summary: American Honda Receivables LLC, as depositor, and Honda Auto Receivables 2026-3 Owner Trust filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus for a $2.105 billion asset-backed notes offering. The notes are backed by auto loan receivables; credit enhancement includes excess spread, subordination, reserve fund, and yield supplement account. This is a routine ABS issuance, not a special situation. No merger, tender, or strategic event occurred. Registration details and note classes are standard for securitization. No special-situation analysis applies; this is a routine capital markets transaction.
